scripts.build: if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ "$BRANCH" = "prod" ]; then cp public/robots.prod.txt public/robots.txt && cp public/_headers.prod public/_headers; else cp public/robots.dev.txt public/robots.txt && cp public/_headers.dev public/_headers; fi && next build
